name: lovett-2026
label: Lovett — Penny Dreadful
description: Show theme for BoonDog Theatre's Lovett, 14-15 August 2026. A Victorian penny-dreadful palette: soot-black ground, aged-parchment text, oxblood as INK (rules, drop caps, the word LOVETT) and tarnished brass as the secondary. Oxblood is used sparingly and never as a field - it should read as printer's ink, not gore. Brass is deliberately close to the Criterion house gold so the display still reads as our foyer hosting a visiting company, rather than a Boondog takeover. Restrained overlay on the Criterion house theme: it retunes ground, accents, texture, watermark and type only. Grid, type scale, lockup geometry, QR card, CTA and next-strip placement stay engine-owned.

_colour_notes.ground: Soot black, warm-shifted from the house ink so the parchment text reads warm rather than blue.
_colour_notes.accent: Tarnished brass. Carries the Criterion continuity - close to the house gold #E4C06B but aged.
_colour_notes.secondary: Oxblood. Deliberately the SECONDARY, not the accent: it appears on rules and emphasis, never as a large field or a background.
_colour_notes.muted_text: Foxed paper, for footlines and small print.

_font_notes: Rye is an ornamented Victorian playbill slab; IM Fell English is a period letterpress serif with a true italic. Both are self-hosted alongside the existing five - see platform/obs-helper/assets/fonts/README.md. NOTE: until the visiting-company-templates task extends APPROVED_FONTS in theme-loader.js, fontToken() will reject these two and fall back to the house Oswald/Inter. That is a safe, legible fallback, not a fault - the display simply looks like dark Criterion rather than penny dreadful until that task lands.
_watermark_notes: An outline cleaver-and-whetstone mark, treated exactly like the Criterion roofline outline in _criterion-default. Deliberately NOT the Criterion roofline: the roofline is saved for the Criterion-owned slides so the two voices stay distinguishable. Position is bottom-left because the engine's corner lockup occupies bottom-right. ASSET NOT YET DRAWN - if missing, the engine falls back to the house watermark, which is acceptable.
_texture_notes: Subtle paper grain, low opacity. ASSET NOT YET DRAWN - absent, the ground renders flat, which is fine.
_poster_frame_notes: Parchment mat suits the portrait show artwork better than the neon 'mount' Popcorn used.
_phase_intensity_notes: No interval key: Lovett runs straight through. Postshow is dimmed for a long, late-running loop in a thinning bar.
